description: Land Title Department - Mudduwa, Ratnapura D/S Division, Ratnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620289
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including their registration details, ownership status (all owned by "The State"), extent measurements, and other land-related particulars. The content is focused on land registration and property ownership matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
